programs.name: Post Graduate Programme in Management (PGP) - Master of Business Administration
programs.feeNote: PGP 2026-28: INR 8,95,000 per year x 2 (stated year totals); mess (INR 48,000/year) and other charges extra.

feeSource.title: IIM Rohtak - PGP 17th Batch (2026-2028) Fee Structure
feeSource.quote: PGP 17th Batch (2026-2028) Fee Structure ... Total Charges 355000 270000 270000 895000 355000 270000 270000 895000 ... Other Fee*: In addition to the above, the mess fee will be Rs. 48000/- per year. [feeTotal = 895000 (PGP I) + 895000 (PGP II), computed; excludes mess, placement facility Rs 40,000, development charge Rs 10,000/yr, alumni Rs 6,500, caution Rs 10,000]

salarySource.title: IIM Rohtak - Final Placement Report 2024-26
salarySource.quote: The highest CTC of this year reached INR 37.10 LPA, while the average and median CTCs stood at INR 20.03 LPA and INR 18 LPA, respectively (PDF text is letter-spaced; de-spaced here)
